requirements.quote:
The salt used to derive Initial keys in Section 5.2 of [QUIC-TLS]
   changes to:

   initial_salt = 0x0dede3def700a6db819381be6e269dcbf9bd2ed9
requirements.condition: when deriving QUIC version 2 Initial keys according to Section 5.2 of [QUIC-TLS]
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use a different salt for QUIC version 2 Initial-key derivation
requirements.why_checkable: The fixed salt supplied to Initial-key derivation can be inspected or compared against the specified 20-byte value in a test vector.
